1.name: Inspired Scholarship
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3480|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7624|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3404|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3455|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff11494|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Echoing Vigor
4.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff17757|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

5.name: Blinding Flare
5.description:
Launch a blinding flare, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies in the target area for |cffffff5|r seconds. Exposed enemies are stunned for |cffffff4|r seconds, and cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds.

While slotted you gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff4042|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.
